subject: physics
question:
A book of mass 0.40 kg rests on a horizontal surface with which it has a coefficient of dynamic friction of 0.50.
If this book is now pushed by an external horizontal force of 10 N, what will be its acceleration immediately after it has started to move?
[Assume the gravitational field strength is 10 Nkg1, that air resistance is negligible and that the orientation of the book does not change.]

subject: physics
question:
An ornamental thermometer, commonly known as a Galileo thermometer, contains a number of spheres of hollow coloured glass, representing different temperatures, immersed in a column of ethanol. A particular sphere (X) rises from the bottom to the top of the column of liquid when the temperature falls below the value it represents.
Which statement best explains why the sphere rises when the temperature falls?

choices.A: The mass of the sphere has decreased.
choices.B: The pressure exerted by the liquid has decreased.
choices.C: The volume of gas inside the sphere has increased.
choices.D: The density of the liquid has increased.
choices.E: The temperature of the sphere is different from that of the liquid.

subject: physics
question:
An earthed magnet is near a bar of material which is seen to be repelled by the magnet.
What could the bar of material be?
[The system is isolated and no currents are induced.]

choices.A: A bar of unmagnetised soft iron.
choices.C: A bar of electrostatically charged copper.
choices.E: A bar of electrostatically charged aluminium.
